body:
# ext #46934 follow-up: one notional helper (Arthur + Alejandro Garcia review, 2026-10-09)
Reviewer feedback (Slack): "why do we need to do the fee calculation in several places / a lot of logic added".
Facts: all six surfaces (order entry page, close, close-all, reverse, auto-close, TP/SL) already called usePerpsOrderFees;
the PR passes USD notional to each. Real duplication: each surface derives notional inline (e.g. perps-order-entry-page.tsx
parses position.size, * currentPrice * closePercent; close-all sums per-position notional) and close-all-positions-modal.tsx
re-implements the hook's fallback-discount math (fallbackMetamaskFees * discountFactor).
Do, in this PR (minimal diff, no behaviour change):
1. One helper next to the hook (ui/hooks/perps/ or ui/components/app/perps/utils/) that returns the order/close notional in USD
   from the inputs each surface has; every surface uses it; no inline parse/multiply left.
2. Close-all reuses the hook's fallback/discount logic (shared pure function) instead of its own copy.
3. Unit tests for the helper; existing tests stay green; the fee screenshots in the PR body still hold (re-run the recipe
   if any fee render path changed; HUD on).
4. Update the PR description's Description bullets to say fees come from one controller quote via one helper.
Rules: do NOT post or reply to any GitHub comment or review thread. Commit and push once to the PR branch when green.
action: Extract shared notional and fallback-discount helpers while preserving controller quotes and batch aggregation.
